fidelityConstraints: Kulrang rang, poʻlat korpus va burama qopqoq saqlanishi kerak

concept.rationaleUz: Oddiy koʻrinishdagi kulrang poʻlat termosning toza studiya sharoitida aniq koʻrsatilishi, ofis va talabalar uchun qulayligi va oddiyligi orqali sotuvni ragʻbatlantirish.
concept.hookUz: Soddalik va mustahkamlik – oddiy kulrang poʻlat termos studiyada namoyish etiladi.
concept.ctaUz: Ishi va oʻqishingizda ishonchli doʻstingiz – hoziroq oling!

shots.descriptionUz: Teremosni toʻliq koʻrinishda studio yoritilgan fon oldida vertikal joylashtirib, asta sekin oldindan yon tomonga kamerani surish.
Burama qopqoqni yaqinlamasdan koʻrsatish, uni qoʻl bilan ochishga tayyorlash, soʻngra qopqoqni koʻrsatmasdan termosning korpusini fokusda saqlash.
Teremosni studiyada markazda biroz tepasidan pas tomonga tiniq yoritilgan holda, uning poʻlat yuzasi va kulrang rangi koʻzga tashlanadigan tarzda yakuniy kadr.

result.promptEn: Use the provided single visual reference of a simple grey steel thermos with a screw cap as the sole visual authority. The thermos has no labels or logos and features a uniform grey steel cylindrical body with a slightly wider, darker grey screw cap. Preserve the visible silhouette, the consistent grey color, the steel material appearance, and the screw cap design without any addition or alteration. The advertisement concept focuses on showcasing the sturdiness and simplicity of the thermos in a clean studio environment, appealing to office workers and students. The tone is clear and minimalistic without distractions. The video opens with a slow side tracking shot revealing the full front and side of the thermos against a plain, well-lit background. The product is vertically framed, emphasizing its slender cylindrical shape. The second shot shows a close-up of the thermos cap area suggesting use by a hand, but without showing the hand or opening action in detail, maintaining focus on the product surface and design. The final shot is a steady, slightly elevated angle that highlights the steel texture and smooth grey color, with soft white lighting to reveal material quality without harsh reflections. No labels or logos appear at any time. The sequence uses smooth transitions with gentle cuts to keep product clarity. Natural product positioning and gravity are observed with no unnatural movements. The audio is subtle ambient studio sounds and soft product foley, with no music or voice. The ending frame is stable, centered, and focused on the thermos alone, ready to impress the Instagram audience. Rendering quality aims for crisp material and color fidelity. Avoid any additions of branding, pattern, or color changes, and do not show any labels or interiors or non-visible parts.
assumptionsUz: Teremosning hajmi va ichki detallarini bilmaymiz, faqat tashqi koʻrinishi boʻyicha ishlaymiz.
Qoʻl bilan ochish yoki tomchasiga issiqlik koʻrsatilmaydi.
reviewNotesUz: Rasmiy yorliq va logotip yoʻqligi aniq tasdiqlangan, shuning uchun hech qanday matn qoʻshilmaydi.
Kameraning harakati va yoritilishi material va rangni yaxshi koʻrsatishi kerak.
